result.topic_en: Two short logarithmic calculations: the logarithms of 13.598 and of another number are each added to the logarithm of 0.7733, which amounts to multiplying the numbers by 0.7733. The page is otherwise blank apart from cut-off text from an adjacent sheet at the right edge.

methods.what: Multiplication by adding common logarithms: $\log_{10}13.598 = 1.1334750$ plus $\log_{10}0.7733 = 0.8883480-1$ gives $1.0218230$. The antilogarithm is noted as 10515,4, i.e. the digits of $13.598\times0.7733\approx10.5154$.
Logarithmic addition of 1.1930689 and the mantissa 0.8883480 (log of 0.7733), giving 1.0814169. This corresponds to multiplying about 15.60 by 0.7733.
